scope: Seven known graphs at one through three loops. Target index patterns overlap across splits; rational kinematic profiles are separate. The dimension is symbolic.
selection: Minimize the sum of complete batch times. Enable a predictor only if it saves at least two percent against the faster control and wins in at least two of three validation repetitions.
